description: Deterministic retrieval evaluation questions for MachineCare AI Starter. Every expected incident ID comes from data/incidents.json.

questions.question: AOI camera inspection is inaccurate after calibration
questions.evidence: AOI-01 incidents whose Cause is 'Camera calibration failed'.

questions.question: The AOI camera keeps moving over time, so inspection results are no longer accurate
questions.evidence: AOI-01 incidents whose Root Cause is camera drift.

questions.question: Why did the camera drift after extended operation?
questions.evidence: Only DT-2026-001 records Root Cause 'Camera drift after extended operation'.

questions.question: Which incident recorded recalibrating the camera and verifying the inspection?
questions.evidence: Only DT-2026-001 records Action Taken 'Recalibrated camera and verified inspection'.

questions.question: What preventive action is associated with sensor failure incidents?
questions.evidence: Incidents whose Cause is 'Sensor failure'; all record Preventive Action 'Replacement schedule'.

questions.question: The conveyor belt keeps slipping during production
questions.evidence: Conveyor machine incidents whose Cause is 'Conveyor belt slipped'.

questions.question: Conveyor belt slipped on the production line
questions.evidence: All incidents whose Cause is 'Conveyor belt slipped'.

questions.question: The pick and place head is losing vacuum because the nozzle is blocked
questions.evidence: The only Pick & Place-01 incident with Cause 'Vacuum loss' and Root Cause 'Nozzle clog'.

questions.question: What is the root cause of the communication timeouts?
questions.evidence: Incidents whose Cause is 'Communication timeout' or 'Fixture communication timeout'; all record a damaged cable as Root Cause.

questions.question: What corrective action was recorded for power interruptions?
questions.evidence: Incidents whose Cause is 'Power interruption' or 'Unexpected power interruption'; all record restarting the equipment.

questions.question: Forklift battery is overheating during charging
questions.evidence: No forklift or battery-charging records exist in the seed data.

questions.question: Hydraulic press is losing oil pressure
questions.evidence: No hydraulic press records exist in the seed data.

questions.question: AOI-01 is emitting a burning smell during inspection
questions.evidence: AOI-01 has incident records, but none describe a burning smell or overheating.
